title: Video by brezojr
description:
Everyone sees the 70kg on fight day, but not the 61kg behind the scenes.
The sacrifices, the hunger, the exhausting days, the sleepless nights and all the moments when you just want it to be over.
People see the fighter stepping into the cage, but they don’t see what it took to get there.
That’s the part nobody sees. That’s the part that makes you stronger.
Respect the process. Always.
